text:
maria.k: Quick heads-up — we're proposing an RBAC split for HSM operators: new roles `hsm_admin` (import/wrap/unwrap) and `hsm_auditor` (list/get/verify). Need to update audit telemetry and the oncall playbook. Any KMS integration owners here? :eyes:

samuel: Sounds sensible. main question: will restricting `ImportKey` break any current customer BYOK onboarding scripts?

chris_l: @maria.k +1 on split. For integrations, most infra uses a service account with overly broad perms today. We'll need a rollout plan: staging flag, canary with a single tenant, then global enforcement.

anya_p: tagging fallout for compliance: logging schema must include `actor_role` and `action_kms_operation` fields, and we need immutable audit entries for any `ImportKey`/`Rewrap`. Legal wants retention aligned with contract SLAs.

maria.k: Agreed on fields. Proposed log shape: `{ "event": "hsm_op", "actor": "<principal>", "actor_role": "hsm_admin|hsm_auditor|...", "operation": "ImportKey|ListKeys|Unwrap", "key_id": "<kid>", "result": "success|failure", "request_id": "<uuid>" }`. Any objections?

chris_l: No objections. Also recommend tagging logs with `customer_tenant` for BYOK to help audits. Will that collide with pseudonymization policies?

anya_p: We can keep tenant id hashed in the application logs and store a reversible mapping in the audit vault for compliance auditors under strict access controls. That mapping access should require a second-person approval.

devops-bot: NOTE: We detected a service account `svc/hsm-migration` with `ImportKey` permission in prod. Owner: infra-team. Please triage before RBAC change.

oncall_bot: Reminder scheduled runbook review with oncall crew: Tue 09:00 UTC. Will include new failure modes for partial import denials and automated fallback to `hosted-fallback` model.

samuel: For vuln triage: if an operator-level key import is attempted by a compromised account, we should rotate the affected key material and run a forensic snapshot of the HSM logs. Do we have a documented playbook?

maria.k: Not fully documented end-to-end. Proposal: add an incident flow in the playbook: 1) detect alert (audit log with suspicious `ImportKey` attempt) -> 2) lock operator accounts (RBAC revoke) -> 3) snapshot HSM audit (export immutable logs) -> 4) rewrap/rotate affected keys -> 5) notify customer and compliance. I'll draft and post for review.

security-bot: TIP: Forcing `ImportKey` to require MFA + ephemeral session reduces risk. Consider integrating HSM operations with short-lived creds from our OIDC broker.

chris_l: FYI — some customers use our KMS proxy which expects `ListKeys` + `GetPublic` from a single principal. We'll need a migration shim or update the proxy to accept auditor principals. I can prototype the shim in staging.

anya_p: Agree on migration shim. Also capture a timeline for legal notifications and SOC approval. I can start drafting the compliance checklist.

maria.k: Thanks. Action items: @chris_l prototype shim + identify impacted tenants, @samuel work with infra to review `svc/hsm-migration`, @anya_p draft compliance checklist, I'll draft the runbook. We'll reconvene after the staging canary. :thumbsup:
